newsitem.title: RUSSIA: Russian MinFins dip, await US Fed meeting, H1 end.
newsitem.headline: Russian MinFins dip, await US Fed meeting, H1 end.

text.p: Prices of Russian MinFin bonds eased in cautious trading as traders were reluctant to open new positions ahead of the next U.S. Federal Reserve meeting on interest rate policy next week, dealers said on Friday.
They added position squaring domained the market in mixed trading ahead of the half-year end.
"It is the end of half-year and the market is drawn by position squaring," Eurobank dealer Olivier Coursault said.
"The market is awaiting further U.S. figures next week so people will not do anything until then," another dealer said.

U.S. Federal Open Market Committee is due to meet on July 1 and 2. MinFins, along with other emerging debt, are sensitive to any news suggesting a change in U.S. interest rates and U.S. Treasury bond prices.
U.S. May personal income and spending figures are also due on Monday and June unemployment is due on Thursday.
